Offline use and install

You can install this page like an app (Add to Home Screen) and save all question pictures so it works without internet.
Questions are from CBSE Class X Mathematics papers (2022–2026, English, Standard and Basic) and were typed in by software, then checked. If something looks different from the printed paper, trust the original picture shown under the question. No answers are given here. Your “done” and “revise” marks are saved in this browser only. Mock papers and worksheets are made up from past questions and are not official CBSE papers. For practice use.
